'''Maram Susli''', also known as Mimi al-Laham, PartisanGirl, Syrian Girl, and Syrian Sister, is a Syrian-Australian political commentator and media personality. Susli was born in Syria, and moved to Australia during her childhood. She is known for her conspiracy-laden commentary on the Syrian civil war, U.S. foreign policy in the Middle East, and other topics.

Her work, including her appearances on InfoWars, often defended the Syrian government under Bashar al-Assad and criticizes opposition groups and Western foreign policies. She has also been associated with various conspiracy theories involving the [[New World Order]] and [[False flag]] operations.
